deskyard computer show: show a computer's state and settings

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] computer show NAME [--json]

Shows a computer's state, image, limits, volumes, access and viewers.
Observers see its state only.

Arguments:
  NAME       string      required  computer name

Options:
  --json               print JSON instead of text
  --server NAME        the server to manage (see `deskyard server list`);
                       default: the server -c SERVER/COMPUTER names, else the
                       default server

Prints: "key: value" lines; with --json the API's Computer object

Examples:
  deskyard computer show alice

Where: on this machine, talking to the server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
